subject: Collaboration slate & timeboxed close plan for Skylift POC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Byrne <alyssa@skylift.io>
Cc: monica_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Collaboration slate & timeboxed close plan for Skylift POC

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet on Wednesday. Per our conversation I put together a short collaboration slate (attached) that lays out a 6-week, timeboxed plan to get Skylift from kickoff to an internal demo and business review. The doc is intentionally lightweight — milestones, owners, and two acceptance criteria we can measure (latency target and sample-quality pass rate).

High level ask: can you review the slate and confirm whether the proposed demo date (week of Sept 28) works for the stakeholders you mentioned? If procurement needs a parallel SOW or PO template, I can push that to them while we finalize the MAP.

Attachments: Skylift_MAP_Slate_v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — draft MAP with timeline and responsibilities

Next steps I propose:
- You: quick thumbs up or edits in the gdoc by EOD Mon (8/30)
- Redwood: final MAP, pricing buckets and PO template delivered Tue (9/1)
- Joint kickoff scheduled for Wed (9/2)

If you prefer, we can convert the slate into slides for the executive briefing — happy to do that.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

---
Context: Skylift is evaluating Redwood for a 6-week POC scoped to customer-facing summarization and a low-latency inference path for search rerank. Goals: validate inference latency at 95th perc < 150ms and embedding similarity quality across 3 test cases.
From: Alyssa Byrne <alyssa@skylift.io>

Cc: monica_cole@redwood.ai, Skylift Procurement <procurement@skylift.io>
Date: 2026-08-25T12:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Collaboration slate & timeboxed close plan for Skylift POC

Thanks Jordan — I skimmed the slate and it looks good. Demo week of Sept 28 works for our PM and Eng leads. I added Procurement on this thread — they will need the SOW and PO template to review in parallel.

Two quick asks from our side: can you add a short risk register section (2–3 items) and a clear rollback/fallback if latency targets aren’t met during the POC? Also please capture who on Redwood will own the weekly engineering sync.

I’ll ask Procurement for preferred PO language; they may push for a two-week payment window.

Best,
Alyssa Byrne
Director, Product & Partnerships | Skylift
alyssa@skylift.io

I made a few edits directly in the Google Doc: added a two-line risk register and a fallback that drops the live latency SLO to a best-effort mode while we instrument a KV cache and enable the quantized variant. I also added a row for "Weekly Eng Sync" and assigned it to Karthik (he'll be our technical PM for the POC).

Quick summary of changes I pushed:
- Risk register (performance, data access, evaluation coverage)
- Fallback plan (cache + quantized model + temporary QPS caps)
- Weekly eng sync owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
- Acceptance criteria clarified: latency 95th <150ms across public dataset A; qualitative sample pass >=80% on our test prompts

I also attached a PO template for Procurement to review (PDF). Jordan — if you want, I can spin up a 2-slide exec brief for the Sept demo in the same doc.

Hello all — procurement here. Couple of items before we can sign off on an initial PO: 1) we need a clear SOW with deliverables and a cancellation clause; 2) please include data handling and retention language (we operate in a regulated vertical); 3) can you confirm estimated spend range for the 6-week POC so we can route approvals?

Prefer to get a redlined SOW by 9/3 so we have time to process approvals. We can accept DocuSign and are ok with Net-30 payment terms but need the payment milestone called out.

Thanks,

Hi — looping in responses and next steps.

On procurement items:
- SOW: we’ll send a short SOW (1–2 pages) that maps directly to the MAP deliverables. Draft will be in your gdoc by 2026-09-01.
- Data handling: we will include the standard Redwood Data Processing addendum and note retention controls. If you need SOC2 artifacts we can provide a summary and a pointer to our compliance pack (we can host during the POC).
- Estimated spend: for the proposed config (2x dedicated nodes, burst capacity for demo runs) expect an initial range of $18k–$25k for the 6-week window. We can tighten after we finalize model/sequence assumptions.

DocuSign: I’ll prepare the DocuSign link once legal approves the SOW; aiming to have the link ready by 9/3 so Procurement can route.

Proposed calendar:
- 2026-09-02: Joint kickoff (60m)
- Weekly engineering sync: Fridays 11:00 PT, owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
- 2026-09-28: Internal demo and exec briefing

If that timeline works, Monica/Jordan — please mark the gdoc as final and I’ll convert to the SOW template for review.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
